亻: The shortened form of 人 (person), written on the left side. Characters with this radical relate to people, personality, or occupations.
口: Means 'mouth'. Appears in characters related to the mouth, speaking, eating, or sounds.
一: Means 'one'. A single horizontal line, often forming the top part of a character.
辶: Means 'to walk/move'. Often used in verbs of movement such as go, come, and pass.
木: Means 'wood/tree'. Appears in characters related to trees, wood, or wooden objects.
讠: The simplified form of 言 (speech) on the left side. Marks words related to speaking, language, or utterance.
心: Means 'heart'. Marks feelings, thoughts, or inner states.
宀: Shaped like a house roof. Appears in characters related to houses, places, or buildings.
氵: Three water drops, the shortened form of 水. Marks characters related to water, liquids, or flows.
扌: The shortened form of 手 (hand) on the left side, marking actions performed with the hands.
日: Means 'sun/day'. Appears in characters related to time, light, or weather.
人: Means 'person'. Marks characters related to human beings.
大: Means 'big'. Depicts a person with outstretched arms, indicating large size.
阝: The shortened form of 阜 (mound) or 邑 (city). On the left it means hill; on the right it means city or region.
纟: The simplified form of 糸 (silk/thread). Appears in characters related to thread, cloth, or rope.
刂: The shortened form of 刀 (knife) on the right side, marking cutting tools or the act of cutting.
广: Shaped like a building with a sloping roof. Appears in characters related to places or rooms.
又: Originally meant the right hand; now often means 'again'. A component of many characters.
攵: Marks the action of striking or doing; appears frequently in verbs.
艹: The shortened form of 艸 (grass) at the top of a character, marking plants.
夕: Means 'evening/night'. Appears in characters related to nighttime.
女: Means 'woman'. Appears in characters related to women or family.
子: Means 'child'. Appears in characters related to children or offspring.
灬: The shortened form of 火 at the bottom of a character, marking heat, fire, or cooking.
目: Means 'eye'. Appears in characters related to seeing or vision.
⺮: The shortened form of 竹 (bamboo) at the top of a character, marking things related to bamboo.
力: Means 'strength/power'. Marks effort, strength, or energy.
土: Means 'earth/soil'. Appears in characters related to land, places, or building materials.
忄: The shortened form of 心 on the left side; marks feelings or attitudes.
八: Means 'eight'. Two open strokes, often serving as a top component.
王: Means 'king' (originally 玉, jade). Appears in characters related to jade or nobility.
十: Means 'ten'. Cross-shaped, often a component of various characters.
月: Means 'moon/month'. Marks time or things related to the moon.
丿: A left-slanting downward stroke; one of the basic strokes forming characters.
小: Means 'small'. Appears in characters related to small size.
凵: Shaped like an open container; marks a place or a hole.
⺼: The shortened form of 肉 (flesh) on the left side, marking body parts or organs.
囗: Shaped like an enclosing box, marking an enclosed place or territory.
巾: Means 'cloth'. Appears in characters related to cloth, clothing, or coverings.
丶: Means 'dot'. One of the basic strokes in Chinese characters.
入: Means 'to enter'. Shaped like 人 but pointing inward.
方: Means 'square/direction'. Appears in characters related to directions or places.
行: Means 'road/to walk'. Marks movement or behavior.
车: Means 'vehicle'. Appears in characters related to transportation.
儿: Means 'son' or depicts legs; appears at the bottom of characters.
里: Means 'village/inside'. Marks distance or the interior.
丨: A vertical stroke; one of the basic strokes forming characters.
见: Means 'to see'. Appears in characters related to sight or opinions.
走: Means 'to walk'. Appears in characters related to moving or going.
禾: Means 'grain/cereal'. Appears in characters related to crops or the harvest.
页: Originally meant 'head'; now often appears in characters related to the head or pages.
亠: Shaped like a lid on top of a character; often appears as a top component.
戈: Means 'spear/halberd'. Appears in characters related to weapons or warfare.
刀: Means 'knife'. Marks cutting tools or the act of cutting.
冫: Two dots, originally 仌 (ice), marking coldness or freezing.
田: Means 'field'. Shaped like a plot of farmland.
廾: Depicts two hands supporting; marks actions done with both hands.
食: Means 'to eat/food'. Marks characters related to food.
生: Means 'life/to be born'. Marks life or growth.
钅: The shortened form of 金 (metal/gold) on the left side, marking metal or metal objects.
丷: Two slanting dots as a top component; often marks separation or the number eight.
石: Means 'stone'. Appears in characters related to stone or hard objects.
衣: Means 'clothing'. Marks characters related to garments.
门: Means 'door/gate'. Appears in characters related to doors or buildings.
牛: Means 'cow/ox'. Appears in characters related to livestock or animals.
覀: A variant of 西 used at the top of characters.
足: Means 'foot'. Marks walking or parts of the foot.
饣: The shortened form of 食 (food) on the left side, marking eating or food.
彳: Marks a step or a road; appears alongside motion radicals.
止: Means 'to stop'. Marks stopping or the foot.
片: Means 'slice/piece'. Marks thin or flat objects.
自: Means 'self' (originally a picture of a nose).
面: Means 'face/surface'. Marks the face or a side.
夂: Marks footsteps; serves as a top component in some characters.
寸: Means 'inch' (a unit of length). Also symbolizes a hand with the pulse point.
手: Means 'hand'. Marks actions performed with the hands.
斤: Means 'axe'. Also used as a weight unit of half a kilogram.
亅: A hooked stroke; one of the basic strokes of characters.
立: Means 'to stand'. Marks an upright position.
二: Means 'two'. Consists of two horizontal lines.
厶: Means 'private'. A simple shape serving as a character component.
夊: Marks a slow step; appears at the bottom of characters.
彡: Marks hair, bristles, or decorative stripes.
水: Means 'water'. Marks characters related to water or liquids.
白: Means 'white'. Also means 'clear' or 'free of charge'.
矢: Means 'arrow'. Marks characters related to arrows or accuracy.
雨: Means 'rain'. Appears in characters related to weather.
匕: Means 'spoon'. Also appears as a character component.
卜: Means 'to divine'. Appears in characters related to divination.
气: Means 'air/gas'. Marks characters related to air or vapor.
氺: A variant of 水 used as a bottom component, marking water.
爫: The shortened form of 爪 at the top of a character, marking claws or hands.
己: Means 'self'. Appears in characters related to oneself.
曰: Means 'to say'. Similar to 口, marks speech.
犭: The shortened form of 犬 (dog) on the left side, marking animals.
耂: The shortened form of 老 (old) at the top, marking age or elderly people.
舟: Means 'boat'. Appears in characters related to ships.
虫: Means 'insect'. Appears in characters related to small creatures.
鸟: Means 'bird'. Appears in characters related to types of birds.
⺌: A small shape resembling 小; a top component in some characters.
匸: Shaped like an open box; marks hiding or covering.
厂: Shaped like a cliff; marks a place or a simple structure.
尢: Means 'lame'. Appears as a character component.
文: Means 'writing/pattern'. Marks characters related to culture or writing.
爪: Means 'claw'. Marks animals or the act of grasping.
瓦: Means 'tile/pottery'. Marks objects made of clay.
禸: Means 'footprint'. A component in some characters.
穴: Means 'cave/hole'. Marks hollow or enclosed spaces.
角: Means 'horn/angle'. Marks angles or animal horns.
身: Means 'body'. Marks the body or the self.
酉: Originally a wine vessel; marks drinks or fermentation.
革: Means 'leather'. Marks goods made of leather.
⺀: Two ice dots, marking cold or freezing.
⺊: A divination component in some characters.
乚: A curved stroke; a component in some characters.
卩: Means 'seal/stamp'. Marks documents or official marks.
尸: Means 'corpse'. Originally a picture of a seated person; marks the body or a place.
山: Means 'mountain'. Marks characters related to mountains or land.
欠: Means 'to owe' or depicts an open mouth.
殳: Marks a striking weapon or the act of striking.
疒: Marks illness or bodily conditions; appears as the outer frame of characters.
示: Means 'to show' (originally an altar). Marks spiritual matters or signs.
礻: The shortened form of 示 on the left side, marking things related to deities or signs.
米: Means 'rice'. Marks staple food or small things.
而: The conjunction 'and/but'. Also appears as a character component.
风: Means 'wind'. Marks weather or air movement.
飞: Means 'to fly'. Marks movement through the air.
